shots.narration_english: On it were verses of the Noble Quran and the qunut dua. I sat listening to the sheikh's recitation. It was a deeply moving recitation.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ކިޔެވުން ނިމުމުން ޝެއިޚް ދުޢާކުރައްވަން ފެއްޓެވިއެވެ. އެއީ އަހަރެން ވަޒީފާއަށް ދިޔަ މަގުމަތީގައެވެ. ހެނދުނުގެ ވަގުތެވެ.
shots.narration_english: When the recitation ended, the sheikh began the dua. I was on the road, going to work. It was morning.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އަދި އަހަރެންގެ މުޅި ހަށިގަނޑު އަހަންނަށް ގޮވަމުން ދިޔައެވެ: "ޝައިޠާނާއާއި ހަވާނަފްސު މަރާލާށެވެ...އޭ ޖަވާދެވެ!
shots.narration_english: And my whole being kept calling out to me: "Kill Shaytan and desire... O Jawad!

shots.narration_dhivehi: ތި ހަޑިމުޑުދާރު ފާޙިޝް ކަންކަމާ ދުރުވެ އިސްލާހުވާންވީ ވަގުތު ޖެހިއްޖެއެވެ. ތައުބާ ވާށެވެ! ފުރުސަތު ނަގާނުލާށެވެ!" އަހރެން ތައުބާވީމެވެ.
shots.narration_english: The time has come to leave those filthy, shameful things and reform. Repent! Don't let the chance slip away!" I repented.
